description:
CONTEXT
In Filament, use_state/1 calls build_setter/3 on every render, creating a new closure each time. This breaks use_memo memoization because the setter appears in dependency arrays and is never equal to its previous version. React solves this at the spec level: useState setters are guaranteed stable (same function reference). Filament must do the same.

FILES TO MODIFY
  lib/filament/hooks.ex
  lib/filament/live_view.ex

CURRENT STATE — hooks.ex
The hook slot for use_state currently stores a plain value. The function build_setter/3 creates a new fn on every call:

  defp build_setter(fiber_id, slot_index, owner_pid) when is_pid(owner_pid) do
    fn new_value ->
      send(owner_pid, {:filament_set_state, fiber_id, slot_index, new_value})
      :ok
    end
  end

And use_state/1 (approximately, read the actual file):
  - reads the slot (gets the plain previous value)
  - calls build_setter/3 every render → new closure each time
  - returns {previous_value, new_setter}

CHANGE — hooks.ex
Change the slot shape from a plain value to a {value, setter} tuple. Create the setter once (when slot is :uninitialized or when no setter is stored), then reuse it on subsequent renders.

New use_state/1 shape:

  def use_state(initial) do
    {index, previous, ctx} = use_slot({initial, :__no_setter__})
    {value, setter} =
      case previous do
        {val, s} when is_function(s, 1) -> {val, s}   # reuse stable setter
        _ -> {initial, build_setter(ctx.fiber_id, index, ctx.owner_pid)}
      end
    commit_slot(index, {value, setter})
    {value, setter}
  end

Key: use_slot/1 is called with a default of {initial, :__no_setter__}. On first render it returns that default; on subsequent renders it returns the stored {value, setter} tuple.

CHANGE — live_view.ex
handle_info({:filament_set_state, fiber_id, slot_index, new_value}, socket) currently writes the raw value directly to hook_slots:

  new_slots = Map.put(fiber.hook_slots, slot_index, new_value)

It must be updated to preserve the existing setter:

  existing = Map.get(fiber.hook_slots, slot_index, {nil, nil})
  setter = elem(existing, 1)
  new_slots = Map.put(fiber.hook_slots, slot_index, {new_value, setter})

CAUTION: After this change, every place that reads a use_state slot and expects a plain value now receives a {value, setter} tuple. Search for consumers of hook_slots that pattern-match on state values. The known consumer in live_view.ex is handle_info(:filament_observable_update) which has its own slot format ({:subscribed, server, value}) and is unaffected. The reconciler (reconciler.ex) does not inspect slot values. The test files in test/filament/ may need updating if they read slots directly.

TESTING
  Run: mix test
  All existing tests must pass.
  Specifically verify test/filament/examples/todo_example_test.exs still passes — it exercises use_state via the todo store indirectly.
  Write or verify a unit test that calls use_state twice in the same fiber render context and confirms the setter returned in render 1 and render 2 are the same function object (using the same_function/2 identity check or === comparison on the fn reference stored in hook_slots).
title: Item 0: Stable use_state setters
